entry.author: Hawke's Bay Regional Council
entry.summary:
We want to know if you've heard us?📣

Take our Community Pulse Survey and tell us what you've heard. Or what you haven't. 
https://hbrc.info/48SaZVr

Our Strategy 2026-2030 | Tā Tātou Rautaki set out how we will focus our mahi and investment to tackle the region's biggest environmental challenges. As part of this strategy, Council decided on three core priorities;
🌊 Reducing flood risk
💧 Supporting water security
⛰️ Promoting land and water health

We want you to know where our focus lies and what we're doing. But this only works if you're hearing us and understand what this means. 

Got a question? 🙋‍♀️ Great - pop it in the comments or send us a direct message and we will get back to you.
